title: Fidelis Emmanuel Sibe Successfully Launches FideTV Online and Spicy Circle
excerpt: Fidelis Emmanuel Sibe, the CEO of FideTV Media, has successfully launched two innovative digital platforms after weeks of dedicated development and preparation.
description: Fidelis Emmanuel Sibe, the CEO of FideTV Media, has successfully launched two innovative digital platforms after weeks of dedicated development and preparation.
content:
Fidelis Emmanuel Sibe Successfully Launches FideTV Online and Spicy Circle

Fidelis Emmanuel Sibe, the CEO of FideTV Media, has successfully launched two innovative digital platforms after weeks of dedicated development and preparation. The platforms — FideTV Online and Spicy Circle — officially went live today, marking a major achievement in his journey as a tech entrepreneur and digital media innovator.

FideTV Online was developed as a modern digital media and streaming platform focused on faith-based content, live broadcasts, inspirational programs, entertainment, and community engagement. The platform is designed to connect audiences through impactful media experiences and meaningful online content.

Alongside it, Spicy Circle was introduced as an energetic entertainment and lifestyle platform built around trending conversations, culture, lifestyle updates, entertainment news, and engaging discussions. The platform aims to create a vibrant online community where users can stay informed, entertained, and connected.

Speaking on the successful launch, Fidelis Emmanuel Sibe expressed gratitude for the progress made throughout the development process, describing the achievement as another step forward for FideTV Media in the digital space.

According to him, the vision behind both platforms is to create digital experiences that inspire, entertain, and bring people together while showcasing creativity and innovation through technology.

The platforms are now officially accessible online:

🌐 FideTV Online — https://fidetv.online
🌶️ Spicy Circle — https://spicycircle.fidetv.online

The successful launch of both websites reflects the growing influence of young Nigerian developers and entrepreneurs who are continuously building impactful digital solutions for modern audiences.

In today’s fast-growing digital entertainment space, creativity and consistency are what truly set individuals apart. One personality steadily building a name through originality, storytelling, and engaging online content is Ndifreke Edet, popularly known on Facebook as Ndifreke Edet

As a content creator, script writer, designer, entrepreneur, and the CEO of NDYBEST UNISEX FASHION HUB, Ndifreke Edet continues to build a strong reputation through creativity, innovation, and dedication to her craft. Through her entertainment brand, NUFH Ndybest Entertainment, she has created a platform focused on relatable storytelling, engaging skits, and inspiring digital content.

The Vision Behind NUFH Ndybest Entertainment

NUFH Ndybest Entertainment represents more than just a media brand. It reflects passion, originality, and the drive to connect with audiences through meaningful and entertaining content. As the CEO of the brand, Ndifreke Edet showcases her versatility across script writing, content creation, digital storytelling, and visual design.

Her social media presence highlights her ability to blend humor, lifestyle experiences, and motivational messages into content that resonates with everyday people. Through skits, vlogs, and creative videos, she continues to grow a loyal audience that appreciates her authenticity and energy.

Fashion Meets Creativity

Beyond entertainment, Ndifreke Edet is also making waves in the fashion industry as the CEO of NDYBEST UNISEX FASHION HUB. Her fashion brand focuses on creating stylish and satisfying outfits for individuals, couples, and families.

With a commitment to quality and elegance, the brand proudly stands on the message:

> “We dress singles, couples and families with a touch of unending fashion satisfaction.”



This reflects her passion for helping people express themselves confidently through fashion while maintaining style, comfort, and uniqueness.

A Rising Voice in Digital Entertainment

One of the most remarkable aspects of Ndifreke Edet’s content is its authenticity. Her videos often reflect relatable life situations, humorous everyday experiences, and motivational insights that connect naturally with viewers.

From funny real-life moments to uplifting messages encouraging people to embrace their individual journeys, her content carries both entertainment and inspiration. This balance has helped her establish herself as a relatable and engaging creator in Nigeria’s growing digital entertainment scene.

Building a Brand with Purpose

Through NUFH Ndybest Entertainment and NDYBEST UNISEX FASHION HUB, Ndifreke Edet continues to prove that creativity has no limits. Whether through storytelling, fashion, entertainment, or digital content creation, she remains focused on building brands that inspire, entertain, and leave lasting impressions.

As her influence continues to grow, Ndifreke Edet stands as an example of passion, consistency, and the power of using creativity to connect with people across different industries.

title: Nene Essien: Leading the Charge Through the NAUS Campus Tour Across Akwa Ibom State
excerpt: In a landscape where student leadership is often reduced to titles and visibility, Nene Essien, popularly known as Peculiar Oluwa, is positioning herself differently. As Chairperson of the National Association of University Students Campus Monitoring Committee, Akwa Ibom State Axis, she is currently spearheading the NAUS Campus Tour 2026, a structured statewide engagement initiative focused on student advocacy, representation, and institutional feedback.
description: In a landscape where student leadership is often reduced to titles and visibility, Nene Essien, popularly known as Peculiar Oluwa, is positioning herself differently. As Chairperson of the National Association of University Students Campus Monitoring Committee, Akwa Ibom State Axis, she is currently spearheading the NAUS Campus Tour 2026, a structured statewide engagement initiative focused on student advocacy, representation, and institutional feedback.
content:
In a landscape where student leadership is often reduced to titles and visibility, Nene Essien, popularly known as Peculiar Oluwa, is positioning herself differently. As Chairperson of the National Association of University Students Campus Monitoring Committee, Akwa Ibom State Axis, she is currently spearheading the NAUS Campus Tour 2026, a structured statewide engagement initiative focused on student advocacy, representation, and institutional feedback.

This is not a ceremonial visitation exercise. It is a field-based engagement model designed to confront student issues directly within their academic environments and translate feedback into actionable representation.

A Campus Tour Built Around Student Reality

Most student leadership structures operate at a distance from the students they claim to represent. The result is predictable: policies and advocacy efforts shaped by assumption rather than lived experience.

The NAUS Campus Tour 2026 is designed to challenge that gap.

Under Nene Essien’s leadership, the initiative is structured around three operational priorities:

Direct engagement with students across campuses
Documentation of academic and welfare-related concerns
Strengthening communication between student leadership and institutional communities

Rather than centralizing discussions in administrative spaces, the tour shifts engagement to lecture halls, student environments, and campus gathering points. The goal is simple but demanding: replace assumption-driven leadership with feedback-driven action.

Expanding Across Major Universities in Akwa Ibom State

The tour has reached several key universities across the state, including:

Akwa Ibom State University,
University of Uyo,
Obong University,
Topfaith University,
Ritman University.

Each engagement is not treated as a symbolic visit but as a working session where student concerns are gathered, categorized, and escalated through appropriate student governance structures.

Leadership Backed by Experience

Nene Essien is a 400 level Philosophy student at Akwa Ibom State University with consistent involvement in student leadership and campus governance spaces.

Her recognition as Miss NAPS at AKSU added visibility to her profile, but her current role is defined less by symbolism and more by operational execution. Coordinating a multi institution tour requires planning, stakeholder communication, logistics management, and consistent field engagement across diverse campuses.

The distinction here is important: visibility creates attention, but execution builds credibility.

Building a Structured Student Voice System

The broader objective of the NAUS Campus Tour 2026 is not limited to outreach. It is aimed at strengthening how student feedback flows into actual representation structures across Akwa Ibom State.

The initiative is focused on:

Capturing recurring academic and welfare challenges across campuses
Strengthening accountability between student leaders and the student body
Encouraging informed participation in student governance
Building inter university awareness and collaboration

A recurring gap in student leadership is not lack of ideas, but lack of structured listening systems. This tour attempts to close that gap through direct engagement.

More Than a Tour

What distinguishes this initiative is not its branding but its method: physical presence, repeated engagement, and structured feedback collection across multiple universities.

The long term value of the NAUS Campus Tour 2026 will not be measured by visuals or publicity. It will be measured by whether student concerns translate into institutional responses, and whether students begin to experience leadership as accessible, responsive, and accountable.

If those outcomes are not achieved, the tour remains activity. If they are, it becomes structure.

title: NBTE Approves 23 New Programmes for Federal Polytechnic Ukana
excerpt: The National Board for Technical Education (NBTE) has approved 23 new academic programmes for Federal Polytechnic Ukana, Akwa Ibom State, beginning from the 2026/2027 academic session.
description: The National Board for Technical Education (NBTE) has approved 23 new academic programmes for Federal Polytechnic Ukana, Akwa Ibom State, beginning from the 2026/2027 academic session.
content:
The National Board for Technical Education (NBTE) has approved 23 new academic programmes for Federal Polytechnic Ukana, Akwa Ibom State, beginning from the 2026/2027 academic session.


The development is a major milestone for the institution as it expands its academic offerings across engineering, technology, sciences, business, security and other professional fields.

The 23 Newly Approved Programmes

The programmes approved by the NBTE are:

1. ND Surveying & Geo-informatics
2. ND Artificial Intelligence
3. ND Estate Management and Valuation
4. ND Building Technology
5. ND Petroleum Marketing & Business Studies
6. ND Crime Management
7. ND Procurement and Supply Chain Management
8. ND Mechatronics Engineering Technology
9. ND Water Resources Engineering Technology
10. HND Science Laboratory Technology (Chemistry Option)
11. HND Science Laboratory Technology (Biochemistry Option)
12. HND Science Laboratory Technology (Microbiology Option)
13. HND Science Laboratory Technology (Physics with Electronics Option)
14. HND Science Laboratory Technology (Environmental Biology Option)
15. HND Cyber Security and Data Protection
16. HND Electrical/Electronics Engineering Technology (Electronics/Telecommunication Option)
17. HND Electrical/Electronics Engineering Technology (Power & Machine Option)
18. HND Electrical/Electronics Engineering Technology (Instrumentation and Control Option)
19. HND Computer Engineering Technology
20. HND Civil Engineering Technology
21. HND Renewable Energy Engineering Technology
22. HND Business Administration & Management
23. HND Accountancy

A Major Expansion for the Polytechnic

The newly approved programmes significantly broaden the range of courses available to students at Federal Polytechnic Ukana.

Of particular interest are programmes in emerging and high-demand areas such as Artificial Intelligence, Cyber Security and Data Protection, Mechatronics Engineering Technology, Computer Engineering Technology and Renewable Energy Engineering Technology.

The approval also strengthens the Polytechnic's offerings in engineering, science laboratory technology, business management, accounting, environmental studies and other technical disciplines.

The new programmes are expected to commence with the 2026/2027 academic session, providing prospective students with more options when applying to the institution.

![image](https://www.image2url.com/r2/default/images/1787083223420-dc50eadd-c16d-4def-8902-9a5b34c157c6.jpg)

What Prospective Students Should Know

Prospective students interested in any of the newly approved programmes are advised to watch out for official announcements from Federal Polytechnic Ukana regarding admission requirements, availability of the programmes and the application process for the 2026/2027 academic session.

FIDE TV will continue to bring you updates on the newly approved programmes, admission processes and other important information concerning Federal Polytechnic Ukana.

content:
Niger Delta Youth Network Unveils National Executive Council


Niger Delta, Nigeria: The Niger Delta Youth Network (NDYN) has unveiled its National Executive Council, comprising young leaders entrusted with the responsibility of advancing the network’s vision, mission, unity, development and collective interests of youths across the Niger Delta region.

The newly constituted National Executive Council is expected to provide strategic leadership and direction as the organization works towards strengthening youth participation in development, promoting peace and unity, and creating opportunities for young people across the region.

Operating under the core values of CONNECT • EMPOWER • TRANSFORM, the NDYN leadership is committed to promoting youth leadership, peacebuilding, entrepreneurship, education, innovation, inclusion, responsible citizenship and sustainable development.

National Executive Council

The National Executive Council comprises the following officers:

1. National President: Comrade Scott Uyiosasere Ogunseri
2. National Vice President (Administration): Comrade Solomon Imafidon
3. National Secretary: Comrade Isoboye Edwin
4. Vice President (West): Comrade Dauda Femiola John
5. Vice President (East): Comrade Chidebere Godspel

7. Assistant Secretary: Comrade Stanley Osaghae

14. Director of Technology & Innovation II: Comrade Adams Aimienoho
15. Director of Stakeholder Engagement: Comrade Ominidougha Pere-Egbewei Stanley
16. Director of Entrepreneurship: Comrade Jite-Eda God’sMajesty
17. Director of Welfare: Comrade Happiness Bibo Adams
18. Director of Women Affairs: Comrade Sandra Osariemen
19. Director of Special Duties II: Comrade Collins Ogieva Osagie
20. Director of Gender Affairs: Comrade Faith Ogaga
21. Director of Students Affairs: Comrade Assor Favour
22. Director of Security, Peace & Conflict Resolution I: Comrade John Uwanogho
23. Director of Security, Peace & Conflict Resolution II: Comrade Aideyan Louis Owamamwen
24. Director of Mobilization I: Comrade Henry Chikodi Dennar
25. Director of Mobilization II: Comrade Yenne Ebobrah Dennis
26. Director of Mobilization III: Comrade Efeyi
27. Director of Mobilization IV: Comrade Samuel Feghaowei Johnny
28. Director of Mobilization V: Comrade Oghogho Ayo Obaseki
29. Director General, Media & Communication: Comrade Akpa Gideon Ifeanyi
30. Director of Media & Communication II: Comrade Udofia Gideon Sampson
31. Director of Media & Communication III: Comrade Fidelis Emmanuel Sibe

A New Commitment to Niger Delta Youths

According to the network, the National Executive Council will work collectively to strengthen youth engagement and create an environment where young people can contribute meaningfully to the social and economic development of the Niger Delta.

The leadership's focus areas include youth empowerment, entrepreneurship, education, technology and innovation, peace and conflict resolution, stakeholder engagement, gender inclusion, student affairs and sustainable development.

With a broad representation across different areas of youth development and advocacy, the council is expected to leverage collaboration and collective action in addressing issues affecting young people in the region.

Building a Stronger Niger Delta

The NDYN says its ultimate goal is to build a stronger, more united and prosperous Niger Delta where young people are empowered to become leaders, entrepreneurs, innovators and nation builders.

The network's message to Niger Delta youths is clear:

“A Stronger Niger Delta Youths for a Greater Tomorrow.”

With CONNECT • EMPOWER • TRANSFORM serving as its guiding principle, the Niger Delta Youth Network says it is committed to building a platform where young people can connect with one another, access opportunities, develop their capacities and contribute to the future of the region.

title: Niger Delta Youths Pass Vote of Confidence on Hon. Desmond Sunday Stephen
excerpt: NDYN Commends His Investment in Youths, Women and Human Capital Development
description: NDYN Commends His Investment in Youths, Women and Human Capital Development
content: Niger Delta Youths Pass Vote of Confidence on Hon. Desmond Sunday Stephen NDYN Commends His Investment in Youths, Women and Human Capital Development The National Delta Youths Network (NDYN) has unanimously passed a Vote of Confidence on Hon. Desmond Sunday Stephen, a distinguished son of Okrika, Rivers State, in recognition of his contributions to human capital development and his continued commitment to the advancement of youths, women and students across the Niger Delta. The commendation was contained in a statement issued by the National President of NDYN, Hon. Comrade Scott Uyiosasere Ogunseri, who described Hon. Desmond as “a blessing to our generation and a beacon of hope to the Niger Delta.” According to Comrade Scott, Hon. Desmond has distinguished himself through sustained investments in people and communities, particularly through initiatives focused on education, entrepreneurship and youth empowerment. Supporting Students and Empowering Communities NDYN highlighted several areas of Hon. Desmond's intervention, including scholarships for indigent students, business grants for women and youths, as well as various empowerment initiatives designed to improve livelihoods and create opportunities for people across communities. Comrade Scott noted that such interventions demonstrate a commitment to leadership that goes beyond words and places tangible impact at the centre of public service. «“In a time when many have abandoned our people, Hon. Desmond Sunday Stephen has chosen to stand with women, youths and students. He is proof that leadership is about service. He is Okrika’s pride and Niger Delta’s hope,” Comrade Scott stated.» NDYN Reaffirms Support The National Delta Youths Network expressed appreciation to Hon. Desmond for his consistent support for young people, women and students, while reaffirming the organisation's solidarity with his efforts toward human capital development. NDYN said it remains committed to recognising and supporting individuals whose contributions positively affect the lives of people across the Niger Delta. The organisation concluded by celebrating Hon. Desmond Sunday Stephen for his contributions and expressing gratitude for his continued efforts toward empowering the next generation. Signed: Hon. Comr. Scott Ogunseri National President, National Delta Youths Network (NDYN) One Voice. One People. One Destiny.
